title: Executing a transition with positive budget
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input word, let $cfg$ be a four-tape configuration over $x$, let $bs$ be a finite Boolean clock word, let $bits$ assign a Boolean to each index below $8$, and let $halt$ be a Boolean flag. Suppose $cfg$ has the pending-action control carrying $bits$ and $halt$, and the little-endian value of $bs$ is positive. After exactly $2|bs|+4$ steps from the six-tape lift of $cfg$ with clock word $bs$, the timed interpreter reaches the lift of one step of the four-tape interpreter from $cfg$, with clock word the fixed-width subtraction of an incoming borrow from $bs$.
hypotheses_covered: A four-tape configuration over $x$ whose control is the specified pending-action state
A finite Boolean clock word $bs$ with positive little-endian value
A Boolean action-bit function indexed below 8
replaced:
If the clock word $w$ has positive little-endian value, then from the six-tape
lift of a pending-action configuration, exactly $2|w| + 4$ steps of the timed
interpreter decrement the budget once and apply the retained action: the
result is the lift of one step of the unstopped table interpreter, with clock
word the borrow subtraction of $w$.
